name: Dairy Products Container
tagline: A squat tapered dairy sample tub with a snap-fit twist lid, modeled to a precise millimeter specification sheet.
description: A tapered frustum-shaped sample tub with a snap-fit twist lid: outward flange skirt over the container rim, a recessed lid field carrying embossed identification text and curved tamper instructions, an integrated tear-strip tab, and a matching rim security-lock nub. The interactive 3D model follows the supplied photo set and modeling specification sheet exactly, to a stated tolerance of +/-0.1mm on the critical rim/seal diameters. Verified supplier composition and CO2 data are still in progress, so no LIMEX percentage or mechanical values are published for this product.
